x-global-obligations: Current recent human primary session, current principal/identity association and exact challenge binding precede every operation and receipt lookup.
Global claim key is SHA-256 of actual proof bytes alone; purpose/transaction is the owner VALUE shared by login and linking across all aliases.
No broker account-link call, email matching, principal/session allocation or grant union. Google Identity Platform tenant profile is blocked.
Atomic association, retained proof claim/consumption, consumed challenge, exact receipt and audit; uncertain outcomes require explicit reconciliation.
No-store/no-referrer on all responses/errors. Suppress callback queries, proof bodies, authorization URLs, cookies and internal identity evidence in logs.
Real provider verification, CSRF/entropy, SQL/races/recovery and broker configuration conformance remain unimplemented producer obligations.
